summary: Go to a page by clicking a link/menu/tab
preconditions: The current page contains a link, menu item, tab, or card that leads to the target destination.
steps: Locate the navigation element (such as a link, menu item, tab, card, or list item) representing the target destination.
If the target page is nested, repeat the process by locating and clicking the next sub-navigation element or specific item link.

variants.when: the target is nested within a category or menu
variants.do: Click the parent category/menu first, then click the specific target item.

variants.when: the target is in a sidebar or header navigation
variants.do: Locate the global navigation bar and click the corresponding tab or link.

watch_for: The URL in the address bar changing.
The page content updating to match the selected destination.
completion_signal: The destination page has fully loaded, displaying the correct URL or page title.
pitfalls: Clicking on a similar but incorrect link (e.g., a different product or post with a similar name).
Clicking on non-interactive text instead of the actual hyperlink.
